Successful prime-time Hindi GEC (Anupamaa, Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai class)? Yes.

calculationFlow: Prime-time slot rate for top Hindi GEC: ~₹3-5 lakh / 10-sec.
Ad slots per 30-min episode: 7-8 min of ads = ~45-48 × 10-sec slots.
Net to broadcaster (after agency commissions, AOR fees): ~₹1.5 Cr.
Plus product placements / branded integration: ~₹15-25 lakh per episode.
Round: ~₹1.5-1.8 Cr per episode for a top Hindi GEC serial.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~₹1.5-1.8 Cr per episode for a top Hindi GEC serial.
